headline: California's athletic commission has reportedly told the organisers of a human-versus-humanoid-robot cage fight to stop, because they had no approval for it.
score_reason: Lowered from 2: the fight and the letter date from mid to late Sep 2026, and the letter is known mainly from the promoter's post.
importance_line: Fighters and spectators of this new kind of show are affected first, then regulators who must fit robots into old sports rules and the promoter REK, but the letter is seen only through the promoter's own post and Futurism says 'apparently'.
summary: Futurism reports that the California State Athletic Commission has apparently sent a cease-and-desist letter (an order to stop) to the organisers of a mid-September human-versus-humanoid-robot cage fight, because such events need the commission's prior approval. Futurism adds that the robot was controlled by a human handler behind the scenes, and Yahoo Sports reports the letter is dated 23 Sep 2026.
notes: Original outlet CyberGuy (cyberguy.com) was blocked (HTTP 403); written from Futurism, cross-checked with Yahoo Sports (https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/california-sends-cease-desist-fight-183535703.html). Event dates before 2 Oct 2026.
